definitions.encoding: Fock n=0..7 = binary b2 b1 b0, b0 LSB
definitions.snap_control: free phases on n=0..7, identically 0 on n>=8
definitions.displacement: expm of NF-truncated generator via spectral factors of i(ad-a); not an 8x8 truncation
definitions.amax_note: 1.5 is inside the repo ansatz soft clip of 1.8; 0.8 and 2.2 are sensitivity, not fictitious large displacements
definitions.F_proc: |Tr(U_tgt^H M)|^2/64, Mij=<i|U|j> on 0..7, global phase free
definitions.eps_X: max(||E+-(I+X)/2||_op, ||E--(I-X)/2||_op), leakage is a third outcome
